rooms.2702: Painted saints crowd both walls of this long hallway, haloed in flaking gold, and every one of them has had its eyes scratched out to bare grey plaster. The air is cold and tastes of old candle wax. To the south the entrance hall breathes a thin draught along the floor, while the hallway runs on east toward more painted walls and west toward a darker, narrower end.
rooms.2706: A painted procession winds along the walls here: robed figures bearing lamps and bones, each face gouged blank by some patient blade. Grave-dirt has been tracked across the tiles in dull brown smears that wander the length of the floor. A low door in the north wall opens on the guard post, and the hallway goes on east and west beneath a ceiling stained black with smoke.
rooms.2707: Bare and cheerless, this guard post holds a long table gouged with old dice marks and a pair of benches, one of them broken clean in half. A rack of rusted pike-heads is bolted to the wall, and a cold brazier sits choked with grey ash. Whoever kept watch here left in a hurry, or never left at all. The only way out is the door back south to the painted hallway.
rooms.2708: Here the painted hallway ends in a martyred saint, a huge figure pierced with arrows, whose scratched-out eyes seem to weep long streaks of flaked paint. The floor is gritty with grave-dirt, and a smell of wet earth rolls in from an iron-banded door to the east. To the north an archway of black stone glows faintly, and the hallway runs west back along the painted walls.
rooms.2709: A ring of runes has been cut deep into the floor of this round chamber, each sign filled with a black crust that might once have been wax or blood. Above it a stone arch stands free of any wall, and the air beneath it shivers like heat over a summer road. The chamber is bitterly cold, and your breath hangs before you. A narrow passage leads north into a smaller room, and the hallway lies south.
rooms.2715: This small square cell is bare except for a scorched circle on the floor, its edges cracked and glassy where some great working burned itself out. The walls are close and sweating, and the stale air smells of lightning and hot metal. A heavy door of black iron stands in the north wall, and an opening south returns to the portal chamber.
rooms.2716: Four ways meet at this bend of the circular corridor, where the curved wall of dark masonry sweeps away on either hand. Old torch brackets hold only stubs of black tallow, and the floor is scuffed with the tracks of many boots. To the north a low arch opens on the chamber of sacrifice, a rust-brown stain spreading across its threshold. The corridor curves east and west, and a door south leads back to the teleport room.
rooms.2727: A broad slab of dark stone fills the middle of this vaulted chamber, grooved with narrow channels that run to its edges and drain into a pitted iron bowl. Chains hang from the ceiling above it, their last links worn bright. Soot and old blood have blackened the walls to head height, and the cold here is the cold of a cellar. The only way out is the arch south into the circular corridor.
rooms.2717: The circular corridor bends here, its inner wall curving close beside you and its outer wall swallowed by shadow. Sconces shaped like clutching hands jut from the masonry, each holding a candle burned down to a lump. A line of grave-dirt follows the curve, as if something heavy had dragged itself along. The passage runs north around the bend, and west toward the junction.
rooms.2718: At this corner of the corridor the walls are slick with damp, and a faded mosaic of a weeping woman is set into the floor, worn nearly smooth by passing feet. A door of dark polished wood stands to the east, carved with ivy and small closed eyes. Cold seeps from its edges. The corridor falls away south toward the bend.
rooms.2719: Faded rose silk hangs in strips from the walls of this lady's chamber, and a great canopied bed sags in the middle of the floor, its coverlet gone to grey mould. A dressing table stands against one wall, its mirror cracked across and veiled with fine dust. Dried flowers lie scattered on the boards, brown and brittle. The sweetish smell of old perfume does little to hide the rot. The only door is west, back to the corridor.
rooms.2726: The corridor curves on here, hugging a wall of close-set black blocks that sweat in the cold. Someone has chalked tally marks in neat rows along the masonry, hundreds of them, ending in a ragged scrawl. A single guttering torch in an iron ring throws long shadows ahead. The passage bends north along the circle, and east toward the junction.
rooms.2724: Here the corridor is narrow and the ceiling sinks low, so that the air feels pressed down upon your shoulders. Damp has raised blisters on the plaster, and in places the wall is bare brick, crumbling at the joints. Fine grave-dirt crunches underfoot. The way runs north along the curve and south toward the junction.
rooms.2723: The circular corridor turns sharply here, and the floor dips in a shallow, worn hollow where many feet have rounded the same corner. Narrow slits high in the wall admit only a cold, thin draught that sets the torch flame leaning. East the passage straightens toward a darker stretch, and south it curves back around the circle.
rooms.2721: A black door of iron-studded oak stands in the north wall of this dim corridor, its surface cut with a spiral of tiny sigils. A thick smell of incense and burnt hair leaks from the gap beneath it. The floor before the door is swept clean, which is more disquieting than the dirt elsewhere. The corridor curves away west.
rooms.2722: A tall altar of polished black stone dominates this vaulted sanctum, its top carved with a spiral and crusted with candle-drippings. Bone-white tapers burn in iron stands around it, giving a light that has no warmth. The walls are hung with tattered black cloth, and the air hums faintly, as if something were breathing in time with your pulse. Behind the altar a niche holds a robed statue whose face has been chiselled away. The door lies south.
rooms.2733: A low wall of black stone marks the edge of the graveyard, and a wrought-iron gate hangs half open in it, its bars twisted into thorny vines. The sky overhead is a flat, bruised grey, and a sour wind carries the smell of turned earth. West, a heavy door leads back into the castle's painted hallway. South through the gate a path of cracked flagstones runs toward the headstones.
rooms.2734: Crooked headstones lean in rows across the sodden ground, their names weathered smooth and their cross-pieces broken. Dead brambles snag at your legs, and here and there a grave has sunk, leaving a dark trough in the grass. A black yew twists above the path, dropping its needles over the stones. The gate lies north, and the ground runs east toward a wider field of mounds.
rooms.2735: Long low mounds of raw earth cover the burial grounds, many of them split open from beneath, with clay heaped around the holes. No grass grows on the soil, and the dull sky presses close above. A collapsed gravediggers' hut leans against a leafless elm. West the path runs back among the headstones, and at the foot of the largest mound a rough stair descends into the dark.

2736.description: A narrow stair has emptied into a low, damp passage below the burial ground, where roots hang through the ceiling like pale fingers. The walls are lined with burial niches, most of them empty and furred with mould. Wet earth drips from above and gathers in black puddles along the floor. A passage leads north into deeper dark, and the stair climbs up to the surface.

2737.description: The passage widens into an irregular vault where the weight of the earth presses on a ceiling of old beams. Bones have been stacked in neat, grinning heaps along the walls, skulls set on top like offerings. The light is faint and seems to come from nowhere. The passage runs south toward the stair, and west it opens into a grander, pillared hall.

rooms.2738: A grand arcade of black pillars stretches away here, each pillar carved into the likeness of a crowned lord with a skull for a face. Between the pillars deep alcoves hold stone benches draped in cobwebs. The floor is paved with worn flagstones, many cracked by roots from above. The arcade runs north to a wider space, and east a rough opening returns to the dark beneath the burial ground.
rooms.2740: This is the heart of the arcade, where the carved pillars stand tallest and the ceiling vanishes into dark. Stone doors face each other across the aisle, the east one bearing the name Drindar and the west one Mernag, both in letters picked out in tarnished gold. A hole in the floor, rimmed with a rusted iron ring, opens on a ladder leading down into the earth. The arcade continues north and south.
rooms.2743: The arcade ends here in a blank wall painted with a huge, faded scene of lords kneeling before a throne of bones. Two tomb doors face one another, the east one marked with a stylised hawk and the west one with a broken crown. Ash lies in drifts along the foot of the wall. The aisle runs back south toward the heart of the arcade.
rooms.2744: Telgar's resting place is a cramped square room dominated by a sarcophagus of grey marble, its lid carved with a knight in full mail, hands folded on a sword. Faded battle banners droop from the ceiling, and the floor is strewn with the husks of long-dead flowers. The air is dry and bitter on the tongue. The only way out is the door west to the arcade.
rooms.2745: Audor's tomb is a bare vault with a plain slab of black basalt pushed askew, as though the occupant had risen and walked away. Scratches score the inside of the lid. A low door in the north wall leads to a dark passage that smells of damp and old death. The tomb's other door, east, returns to the arcade.
rooms.2753: Beyond the tomb door a narrow tunnel of black rock begins, so low that anyone tall must stoop. Names have been scratched into the walls with fingernails or knives, thousands of them, overlapping into a grey scribble. The floor is slick and cold underfoot. The tunnel runs north into the dark, and south back to the tomb.
rooms.2754: The tunnel turns here, and the wall at the corner has been worn smooth and dark by hands feeling their way through the black. Bone fragments crunch in the grit, and a draught of cold air smells of wet iron. Chipped letters over the corner urge you, in an old shaky script, to turn back. East the tunnel continues, and south it goes back toward the tomb.
rooms.2756: Here the tunnel narrows until your shoulders brush both walls, and the ceiling hangs so low that you must stoop. A bleached hand of bone juts from a crack in the wall, fingers curled around nothing, a grim relic of the poor souls sealed in alive. Water drips somewhere ahead in slow, patient beats. The way goes north into the narrower dark, and west back to the bend.
rooms.2758: A pool of black water has gathered across the floor of the tunnel, ankle deep and perfectly still, so that the dim light of a distant sconce lies on it like oil. The walls here are stained green with seepage, and the smell is of a cellar long flooded. Scraps of rotted cloth drift at the edges. The tunnel runs east beyond the pool and south the way you came.
rooms.2760: Heavy chains hang in loops from iron rings set in the walls of this stretch, rusted to the colour of dried blood, and some still end in empty manacles. The floor is churned with old scrapings, and the roof is sooty with generations of smoky torches. A low moaning of wind comes and goes. You can go east deeper in, or west back toward the pool.
rooms.2761: The tunnel bends sharply here around a great buttress of black rock that seems to have been left uncut, glistening with damp. Candle stubs have been jammed into every crevice of it, burned down by long-dead mourners. Faint scratch marks cover the floor in long parallel lines. North the passage goes on, and west lies the way back.
rooms.2763: A pair of crude pillars, hacked from the living rock, hold up the roof of this stretch, each carved with a leering death's head. The air grows colder and thicker with every step, and the dark between the pillars seems to lean toward you. A trail of grave-dirt marks the floor. The way continues east, and back south the tunnel bends away.
rooms.2765: Ribs of old timber brace the ceiling here, bowed and greyed with rot, and dust sifts from them whenever the air stirs. Someone has painted a faded red hand on the wall, palm out, as a warning or a blessing. The floor is littered with heaps of bone chips and dried candle drippings. The passage runs north, and west toward the cold pillars.
rooms.2767: Black mould blooms across the walls like a second, softer skin, and the air is thick with spores and rot. A single skull has been set into the wall at head height, and its empty sockets seem to follow you. Somewhere ahead a sickly green glow stains the dark. East the passage continues toward the glow, and south it returns to the red hand.
rooms.2769: The tunnel ends in a stout door of black iron to the east, riveted and streaked with rust, its ring-handle shaped like a gaping mouth. A cold green glow seeps from the crack beneath it, and the smell of old incense is stronger here. The walls on either side are scored with deep, clawing gouges. Back west the tunnel winds away into darkness.
rooms.2770: The tunnel ends in a small round room whose domed ceiling is stained with soot and whose walls are lined with narrow ledges. Rows of ancient oil lamps sit on them, all dry and cold. In the middle of the floor a circular grate covers a well of utter darkness, from which rises a sour wind. The only exit is the iron door west.
rooms.2741: Drindar lies in a tomb hung with moth-eaten crimson, and the great stone chest that holds him has its lid split lengthwise as if from within. Dry petals and splinters of bone litter the floor around it. A rusted crown of iron, much too large for any living head, is carved into the wall above. The cold here has a heavy, listening quality. A door in the west wall leads back to the arcade.
rooms.2742: Mernag's tomb is a squat chamber with a ceiling of low arches, each one crusted with white salt left by seeping water. His coffin is of lead, sealed with twisted bands, and the floor around it is scored with a ring of deep scratches. A bowl of long-dried incense sits on a niche shelf. The air is sharp as brine. A door leads back east to the arcade.
rooms.2739: This hidden tomb was cut secretly beneath the arcade, and its low vault is crowded with burial slabs, each bearing a single carved name. A ladder of iron rungs climbs up through a hole in the ceiling, rubbed shiny by hands. The air is still and dry, as though no draught had stirred it in an age. An opening in the east wall leads on into a narrow passage.
rooms.2746: A narrow passage of mortared brick turns here, so tight that two people could not walk abreast. Lamp niches have been cut into the wall at intervals, each blackened by soot. A cobweb heavy with dust drapes from one wall to the other. The passage runs north into the dark, and west it opens into the hidden tomb.
rooms.2747: Small, many footprints have worn a path down the middle of the dust here, as of some patient keeper walking his rounds night after night. The brick walls are sweating, and a cold trickle runs down one corner into a crack. A single hook in the ceiling holds nothing at all. The passage goes north and south.
rooms.2748: A thin line of damp runs down the middle of the wall, leaving a green track like the path of a snail. Mortar crumbles from between the bricks, and several have fallen out to leave dark gaps that breathe a stale air. Far off, something taps against a pipe in a slow, uneven rhythm. The passage continues north and south.
rooms.2749: A cracked clay lamp hangs from an iron hook here, long out of oil, its wick a curl of black ash. The walls bear faded daubs of white paint, crude marks in tallies of five, as if someone had once counted the days. The floor is covered with a fine pale grit. The passage runs north and south.
rooms.2750: The passage grows warmer here, and a smell of tallow and old smoke comes down it, as of a hearth recently lit. The brickwork is stained brown with soot to head height. Beneath the soot, someone has scratched tiny faces into the mortar, dozens of them, all with the mouth open. The passage goes north toward the warmth and south the way you came.
rooms.2751: The passage ends in a small landing with a worn doorsill to the east, where the plank door is propped with a wedge of old bone. A horseshoe has been nailed above the lintel, rusted solid, and a keyring hook hangs empty beside it. The air carries the sour smell of cold broth. The passage lies south.
rooms.2752: A keeper's cot, a table and a cold iron stove make up this cramped room, with everything thick under soot and grave-dust. A great ledger lies open on the table, its entries running in a cramped hand until the ink simply ends in a long brown smear. Pegs on the wall hold rows of empty key rings, and a bucket by the stove holds only dried mud. The only way out is the door west.
rooms.2704: Here the painted hallway comes to a dead end of crumbling saints, their halos green with damp and their faces scratched blank. A faint smell of paper and mildew drifts from a door of dark wood set in the south wall. Cobwebs cling to the high corners. The hallway lies east.
rooms.2725: Tall shelves of blackened oak crowd this library, bowed under rows of rotting books whose spines have crumbled to powder. A reading lectern stands in the middle of the room, its slanted top scarred with ink and knife cuts. A ladder on iron wheels leans against the highest shelf, and a thick mat of dust lies over everything. Pale scraps of torn pages drift in the draught. The door is north, back to the end of the hallway.

2722.description: The altar is a single block of black stone, polished by years of hands and sleeves. Its spiral is cut so deep that the candle wax has run into it like a river into a maze. Dark stains have soaked the grooves and never washed out.

2727.description: The slab is cold as a river-stone and worn hollow along its centre. Each channel in its flank ends in the iron bowl, which is crusted brown and rimmed with nicks.

2708.description: The martyred saint is shown bound to a post, ringed with black-fletched arrows. Someone has scratched out both eyes and then, as an afterthought, the mouth.

2709.description: The runes are cut in an angular script that hurts to follow with the eye. The arch above them is blank and black, but the air under it keeps moving as though a door stood open on something far away.

2734.description: The names on the headstones have been chiselled away or smoothed over, and in their place the same sign is cut again and again: a small spiral. Some of the stones look newly scraped.

2740.description: Every pillar wears a crown and a death's head, and no two crowns are alike. At the foot of each is a name plate, but the brass has been hammered flat on all but a few.

creatures.long_desc: A robed cultist mutters over a string of knucklebones, his eyes fixed on nothing.
creatures.description: A gaunt man in a grave-grey robe, his sleeves stained to the elbow. His lips move in a ceaseless whisper, and a tarnished spiral hangs at his neck.
rooms: The West End Of The Painted Hallway

creatures.long_desc: A rattling skeleton shambles along the tunnel with a rusted blade in its fingers.
creatures.description: Yellowed bones held together by nothing you can see, with scraps of burial cloth clinging to the ribs. Its jaw clicks open and shut, though no sound comes.

creatures.long_desc: A wailing ghost drifts among the headstones, its pale face turned toward the sky.
creatures.description: A thin shape of fog and grave-cloth, drifting a hand's breadth above the ground. Where its eyes should be there are only two dark smudges, and the cold rolls off it in waves.
rooms: The Arcade Of The Undead Lords

creatures.long_desc: An armoured tomb guard stands motionless between the pillars, a notched sword in both hands.
creatures.description: A tall dead warrior in black plate, the metal pitted and split. Beneath its helm there is only a dry grin and a pinprick of cold light, and it stands as if it has stood a thousand years.
rooms: The Arcade Of The Undead Lords

creatures.long_desc: A blood cultist in a crimson-banded robe trails his fingers along the corridor wall, humming softly.
creatures.description: A lean priest of Lord Khal with a red spiral painted across his brow and a curved bone knife at his belt. His hands are stained dark to the wrist, and his smile is almost kind.

creatures.long_desc: Mania, the Pale Lady, sits at her dressing table combing hair that is no longer there.
creatures.description: A ghost in a faded rose gown, once a lady of the castle, now a thing of cold light and cracked porcelain. She turns toward you slowly and smiles the way a mirror smiles when no one is looking.

creatures.long_desc: Lord Khal, the necromancer, stands behind his black altar with a pale hand raised over a burning taper.
creatures.description: A tall, spare man in black robes edged with silver thread, with a skull-white face and eyes that never blink. The air around him is thick with the smell of old candles and grave-earth, and the light bends away from his hands.

items.room_desc: A grave-grey robe lies in a heap here.
items.description: A heavy wool robe the colour of old ash, its hem stiff with dried mud. A small spiral is stitched inside the collar.

items.room_desc: A tarnished silver ring lies here.
items.description: A thin ring of dull silver, taken from a burial. It is worth something to those who do not mind where it came from.

items.room_desc: A notched black sword lies here.
items.description: A broad, heavy blade of dark iron, worn from age and nicked along its edge. The cold of the grave never quite leaves the grip.

items.room_desc: A pale lace veil lies here.
items.description: A veil of ivory lace, yellowed at the edges and perfumed faintly with rose and rot. It hangs lighter than it should.

items.room_desc: A staff of black yew lies here.
items.description: A tall staff of blackened yew topped with a spiral of silver wire. It is cold to the touch and hums softly when held.
